content: Bii bwisiɡii u rɑ win tundon sɔ̃ɔsiru swĩiwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bii wi u tii sue, u ku rɑ ɡerusibu kɑ̃.
Gemɡibu bɑ rɑ ben ɡɑrin ɑre wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu, dɑm dɔrenɑɑn wɑ̃ɑrɑ bɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u win nɔɔ kpĩɑ u win hunde kɔ̃suwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ ɡɑri ɡere yɑbi u tii kɑri bɔriemɔwɑ.
Yikuro u rɑ n ɡɑ̃ɑnun binɛ mɔwɑ ni u ǹ kpɛ̃ u wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ sɔmburu ko u rɑ wɑwɑ ye u kĩ.
Gemɡii u ku rɑ weesu kɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ tii sekuru dokewɑ.
Wi u win tii nɛni dee dee, win dɑɑ ɡeɑ yɑ koo nùn kɔ̃su, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀, kɔ̃sɑ yɑ koo nùn surɑ.
Gobiɡiin kookoosɑ ɡɑbu bɑ rɑ n mɔ̀, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ. Kpɑ ɡɑbu bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe sɑ̃ɑrobu, ɑdɑmɑ beyɑ bɑ ɑrumɑni mɔ.
Gobiyɑ ɡobiɡii u rɑ kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru yɑkie, ɑdɑmɑ ɡoo ku rɑ sɑ̃ɑro wɔri.
Gemɡii u rɑ n bɑllimɔwɑ nɡe yɑm bururɑm, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe fitilɑ ɡe ɡɑ ɡɔɔ dɔɔ.
Tii suɑbu bu rɑ kɑ sɑnnɔ nɛwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ kɑ bwisi kɛ̃ru sɔmburu ko, bwisiɡiiwɑ.
Dukiɑ ye tɔnu wɑ kɑ keetɑn swɑɑ yɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ fuuku, ɑdɑmɑ ye tɔnu wɑɑmɔ fiiko fiiko kɑ swɑɑ ɡeɑ, yɑ rɑ sosiwɑ.
Ye tɔnu yĩiyɔ yɑ̀ kun koore, yɑ rɑ nùn kowɑ bɑrɔ, ɑdɑmɑ yĩiyɔ bi bu yibiɑrɑ bu rɑ kowɑ nuku doo bɑkɑbu.
Wi u bwisi kɛ̃ru yinɑ u koo yen ɑre wɑ. Wi u mɑɑ tu wurɑ u koo yen ɑre wɑ.
Bwisiɡiin sɔ̃ɔsiru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑ̃ɑrun nuuru. Tɑ rɑ tɔnu yɑrewɑ ɡɔɔn yinɑn di.
Bwisiɡiin bwisi yi rɑ dewɑ bu nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃son sɑnu sɑnusu su rɑ nùn kɑm kowɑ.
Wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ u rɑ bwisikuwɑ u sere ɡɑ̃ɑnu ko, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ ɡɑ rɑ ɡen ɡɑri bɑkɑru tɛriewɑ.
Sɔmɔ kɔ̃so, wɑhɑlɑwɑ u rɑ kɑ nɛ, ɑdɑmɑ sɔmɔ ɡeo u rɑ tɔmbu nukuru yɛmiɑsiewɑ.
Wi u sɔ̃ɔsiru yinɑ u koo kowɑ sɑ̃ɑro kpɑ u sekuru wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u tu wurɑ wiyɑ u koo bɛɛrɛ wɑ.
Ye tɔnu u kĩ, yɑ̀ n koorɑ, yɑ rɑ nùn nuku dobu wɛ̃wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ ku rɑ kɑ̃ bu ben kɔ̃sɑ deri.
Wi u rɑ bwisiɡii bere, u koo bwisi wɑ. Wi u rɑ n mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu, u koo kɔ̃sɑ wɑ.
Kɔ̃sɑ yɑ rɑ durumɡibu nɑɑ swĩiwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ duromɑ mu rɑ ko ɡemɡibun ɑre.
Tɔn ɡeon dukiɑ yɑ rɑ kowɑ win bibun bweseruɡiɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃soɡiɑ yɑ rɑ kowɑ ɡemɡibuɡiɑ.
Sɑ̃ɑrobu bɑ rɑ dĩɑ ɡeenu wɑ ben ɡberun di, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑbuɡiɑ rɑ ɡberewɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ǹ ɡem swĩi.
Wi u ku rɑ win bii sɛɛyɑsie u ǹ nùn kĩwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u nùn kĩ u rɑ nùn sɛɛyɑsiewɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ n deburu mɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n ɡɔ̃ɔru bɑrɔwɑ.
